script: セイバールート三日目-01
title: セイバールート三日目-01

pages.ja:
部活がある桜と別れて校舎に向かう。
校庭には走り込みをしている運動部の部員たちがいて、朝から活気が溢れている。

pages.en:
I part ways with Sakura, who has club activities, and head toward the school building.

The athletic clubs are running drills across the schoolyard. Even this early, the grounds are full of life.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I leave Sakura, who has club activities, and head to the school building.
The schoolyard is full of spirited students running around.

pages.ja:
「…………」
にも関わらず、酷い違和感があった。
学校はいつも通りだ。
朝練に励む生徒たちは生気に溢れ、真新しい校舎には汚れ一つない。

pages.en:
“…………”

And yet something feels terribly wrong.

The school looks the same as ever.

The students at morning practice are full of life, and not a speck of grime mars the brand-new building.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
But still, there’s something oddly wrong here.
The school is like it always is.
The students at morning practice are lively, and the new school building is spotless.

pages.ja:
「……気のせいか、これ」
なのに、目を閉じると雰囲気が一変する。
校舎には粘膜のような汚れが張り付き、校庭を走る生徒たちはどこか虚ろな人形みたいに感じられる。

「……気のせいか、これ」

pages.en:
“…Am I imagining it?”

But when I close my eyes, the atmosphere changes completely.

Something like a slimy membrane coats the building, and the students running across the schoolyard feel like hollow puppets.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Maybe it’s just my imagination.”
But when I close my eyes, the air completely changes.
The school building is covered with stains like membranes, and the students running around the schoolyard seem like empty dolls.

I give my head a quick shake and make for the building.

to clear it.

pages.ja:
土曜日の学校は早く終わる。
午前中で授業は終わり、一成の手伝いを終えた頃には、日は地平線に没しかけていた。
「さて、そろそろ帰るか」
荷物をまとめて教室を後にする。

pages.en:
School ends early on Saturdays.

Classes finish before noon, but by the time I'm done helping Issei, the sun is almost below the horizon.

“All right. Time to head home.”

I gather my things and leave the classroom.

original.en:
“…There are a lot more carbon-fiber bows now, though. A year ago, there was only one.”

Carbon-fiber bows have all sorts of practical advantages over plastic or wooden ones.

Their biggest drawback is the price. They were far beyond the club’s budget.

Back then, Shinji was about the only one who used one. Maybe the newer members are fairly well-off?

“…What a waste. There’s so much more you can do to customize a wooden bow.”

Well, I suppose that comes down to personal preference.

I glance at the clock and see that the school's closing time is long past.

It is a little after seven. The school gates have probably been closed by now, so there is no longer any point in rushing home.

Perhaps driven by the fierce wind, clouds stream overhead.

Closing time has passed. The empty school grounds retain not a trace of warmth.

There’s no light in the sky when I look up.
Because of the strong winds, the clouds are moving fast.
It’s past curfew and there’s no sign of life in the empty school.

pages.en:
“————————”

But the instant I see them, I know.

They are not human. They must be something else that merely resembles humanity.

I don't know this because I have studied magecraft.

Anyone would understand at a glance that those things are not people.

Human beings are not creatures capable of moving that way.

Whatever they are, I must not become involved.

“————————”

Even at this distance, their murderous intent reaches me.

…I'll die.

My body understands before my mind that if I remain here, I cannot possibly survive.

That is why my heart is hammering.

One living creature to another, I recognize that those things exist solely to kill.

“————————”

…They wield weapons made to kill with far greater certainty than any knife or kitchen blade.

Yesterday's murder flashes through my mind.

The family was said to have been butchered with something resembling a sword.

“—”

I must not keep watching.

And still my body will not twitch. I cannot even breathe.

My mind screams that I must run,

and answers that the slightest flight will reveal me.

More powerful than that struggle, paralysis numbs my arms and legs.

Though I am more than forty meters away, I feel as though that spear is leveled against me from directly behind. I can barely draw breath.

“————————”

The sound stops.

The two things break apart and stand facing one another across the distance.

The instant relief tells me their killing is over, a still fiercer wave of bloodlust reaches me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
I just knew immediately when I saw them…
They are not human. They are probably just things that look like humans.
I can tell not because I’m learning magic.
Anyone would realize they’re not human.
After all, humans can’t move like that.
So they are something no one should associate with.
“”
I can feel their murderous intent even from a distance.
…I’m going to die.
My body understands faster than my brain that I will definitely die if I stay here.
That’s why my heart is racing so fast.
As a living thing like them, I sense that they’re living things made only to kill.
“”
…They’re using weapons made only to kill.
I remember the murder yesterday.
They said the family was killed with some weapon like a sword.
“…!”
I shouldn’t watch any longer.
But my body won’t follow my commands and I can’t even breathe.
My mind wants to run away, but my judgment tells me I’ll be seen the moment I run away.
…More than the conflict within me, my body is just numb.
Even though I’m over forty meters away, I can’t breathe properly, and it’s like I have a spear pointed right at my back.
“”
The sounds stop.
The figures separate and stand facing each other.
The moment I feel relief at the end of their battle, I sense an even stronger intention to kill.

I stop my feet, unable to take another step, send oxygen to my pumping heart, and look up to finally realize that I am safe.

……それは死に行く為の眠りではなく。
再び目覚める為に必要な、休息の眠りだった。
pages.en:
“————————”

My heart begins to beat again.

Then, at last, consciousness leaves me.

…Not the sleep of a man descending into death,

but the rest my body needs in order to wake once more.
